scope_ambiguity: Scope ambiguity is triggered but no scope contract or explicit shrinkage decision is configured. This story_review row is advisory only; ProofStory gates consume CLI-written artifacts, not prompt text.

None of the checklist items have the files field filled in (legacy story compatibility mode); cannot perform coverage validation on understanding.touchpoints. Please list the changed files in files.modify/create/test for at least one item to enable strict touchpoint-to-files validation
High-risk stories must have plan.md (execution plan). Write it following the plan.md template in CLAUDE.md, one section per CHK-xxx

missing_scope_check: scope-check.json is missing PLAN gate evidence. Start a story-level PLAN scope reviewer with `lattice dispatch --storyId=B-19ca --agentType=lattice-review-scope-plan`; dispatch output is not gate evidence, and the lattice-review-scope-plan / scope-plan reviewer must finish by calling `lattice scope_check_save`. The implementation/main agent must not self-sign this evidence or manually edit story metadata. Local CLI guidance is not remote completion and must not be presented as receipt verification or production/full completion.
own scope contract for B-19ca is unreadable; allowing (fail-open)
